title: Yellowed Shattering Irish Lamb Skillet
description: A citrusy one-pot Irish dish featuring ground annatto and a shattering crust, high in protein and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the ground lamb and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the dried thyme, lemon zest, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the diced potatoes to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the ground annatto over the top.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned and shattering.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
